The chart is a horizontal bar chart that presents the results of a survey on measures to limit the "shadow economy" in a country. The vertical axis lists various measures, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents who support each measure. The chart features two colors, blue and red, which are used to differentiate between the responses. The measures are listed in no particular order, and the percentages range from 2% to 13%. The chart highlights that the most popular measures are "Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система" (13%), "Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса" (9%), and "Да се ограничи дейността на мафията" (10%). The least supported measures are "Да се засили граничния контрол" (2%) and "Да се намалят акцизите" (2%). The chart provides a clear visual representation of the respondents' opinions on the most effective measures to limit the shadow economy.
